subtitle: Payload update checker, auto shutdown and PS4 documentation.
s6Body: Every folder below is read automatically: the repo comes from the .url file inside the folder, no need to type it by hand. You can update straight from this page (git pull). Requires the page to be served over HTTP.
errFileProto: On file:// the browser can't read local files. Serve the page over HTTP.
errNotFound: Can't find {path} — check the folder structure.
asBody: The “Auto server shutdown” checkbox in the hub corner powers the rpi off once GoldHEN starts on the console. It works on any network set up on the rpi (the PS4 LAN over Ethernet, or Wi-Fi), with any exploit — local or online — as long as the GoldHEN payloader is listening on port 9090.
asWarn: The console must be on one of the rpi’s networks (the PS4 LAN or the same Wi-Fi); otherwise the server can’t find it or reach port 9090.
asStep1: The server finds the console on the network by itself (PS4 Device Discovery or the Ethernet DHCP lease) and remembers its IP; it also picks it up when the PS4 opens the hub.
asStep2: Every 5 seconds the server checks whether port 9090 is open on the console (the GoldHEN payloader).
asStep3: Once the port answers and the checkbox is on, a 5-minute safety delay starts.
asStep4: At the end it runs poweroff. Unticking the checkbox in the meantime cancels the shutdown.
asNote: After poweroff the rpi only starts again by unplugging and replugging its power (Wake-on-LAN does not work on this Pi).
